title: The Second World War and the Recovery of Western Europe
description: Examination of the effects of the Second World War on Europe, and the recovery of the Western European states in the postwar period.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EUS340, HIST 367, HSTR 344C.
recommendations: HSTR 112A and HSTR 112B, or HSTR 240A and HSTR 240B recommended prior to EUS 340.
